learning_outcomes.text: Understand the basic properties of circuits with time-varying voltages and currents.
Know the basic methods for the analysis of linear resistive circuits of two-terminal elements) and introduction to circuits with ideal controlled sources.
Know the basic methods for phasor analysis of two-terminal elements circuits in sinusoidal steady state.
Apply knowledge and methods to solve introductory linear circuits.
Develop autonomous reasoning skills with reference to the introductory circuits indicated.
Correctly use the technical terminology of the field.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to linear resistive circuits with ideal controlled sources
Circuits with time-invariant voltages and currents: some first-order cases and introduction to second-order circuits
Two-terminal element circuits in sinusoidal steady state
Series RLC circuit in sinusoidal steady state
Parallel RLC circuit in sinusoidal steady state

assessment_methods.method: Exercises section of the written exam
Theory section of the written exam

assessment_rules: The exam is in person, in written form, consisting of an exercises section and a theory section. Should there be any interpretive doubts regarding what is reported in the written test, the professor may require an oral exam.
bibliography: The texts for the theory section and the exercises section, in pdf format, will be made available on Moodle during the course.
institution: Università degli Studi di Padova — Information Engineering (L-8)
degree: Laurea in Information Engineering (Information Engineering), classe L-8 R Ingegneria dell'informazione
